DIV5.HEAD: PART 71—DESIGNATION OF CLASS A, B, C, D, AND E AIRSPACE AREAS; AIR TRAFFIC SERVICE ROUTES; AND REPORTING POINTS

SOURCE.P: Doc. No. FAA-2024-19448, 89 FR 67845, Aug. 22, 2024, unless otherwise noted.

DIV6.HEAD: § 71.1 Applicability.
DIV6.P: A listing for Class A, Class B, Class C, Class D, and Class E airspace areas; air traffic service routes; and reporting points can be found in FAA Order JO 7400.11J, Airspace Designations and Reporting Points, dated August 12, 2024, and effective September 15, 2024, which is incorporated by reference in 14 CFR 71.1. The incorporation by reference was approved by the Director of the Federal Register in accordance with 5 U.S.C. 552(a) and 1 CFR part 51.
